name: Shore Temple
shortDescription: A UNESCO World Heritage structural stone temple complex built by the Pallava dynasty, standing directly on the Bay of Bengal coastline.

name: Pancha Rathas
shortDescription: Five monolithic rock-cut temples, each carved from a single stone, named after the Pandava brothers and Draupadi from the Mahabharata.

name: Arjuna's Penance
shortDescription: One of the largest open-air rock reliefs in the world, depicting a Pallava-era narrative carved into a massive granite boulder.

name: Krishna's Butter Ball
period: Natural formation, culturally significant since antiquity
shortDescription: A giant balancing granite boulder resting on a short slope, a natural geological formation woven into local Krishna legend.

name: Tiger Cave
shortDescription: A rock-cut cave shrine with a distinctive facade of carved yali (mythical lion) heads, likely used for royal ceremonial purposes.
